nodes.name: Schedule: 10AM ET Daily
nodes.notes: 10:00 AM America/New_York every day. n8n workflow timezone is set to America/New_York (handles DST). Best time for Long Island local search traffic: 9-11 AM ET per Google Search Console data.

nodes.name: Code: Validate Auth + Build Post Payload

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: 3, params: { model: 'blog.post', method: 'read', args: [[ $('HTTP: Odoo Create Blog Post').first().json.result ], ['id', 'name', 'website_absolute_url']], kwargs: {} } }) }}

main.node: Code: Validate Auth + Build Post Payload

notes: SETUP: 1) Create HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic Claude API Key' with Header=x-api-key, Value=your-sk-ant-api-key. 2) Import this JSON into n8n. 3) Activate. Runs 10AM ET daily. No other credentials needed — Odoo auth is handled inline.
